impact: The new observer test helper leaves the production 100ms real-clock deadline active in filesystem/content/cache tests. If a CI worker or filesystem pauses for over 100ms between observe() starting and its asynchronous realpath/lstat/open/read steps, the implementation correctly returns undefined while tests such as 'reads the latest valid turn-context model' require a model, producing a false CI failure. Read the full test file and observer deadline implementation and checked all maxDurationMs/now/scheduleTimeout overrides: only the sparse-read and explicit deadline cases override some timing; ordinary positive cases still use Date.now and a real 100ms timer. The manual-deadline test also overrides scheduling without freezing the elapsed-time clock, so it can expire before reaching its open gate.
resolution: Observer functional test helper now supplies a frozen clock and inert scheduler, with per-test overrides last. Explicit deadline cleanup, elapsed-budget and TTL tests remain active. All 17 observer tests and focused ESLint pass.
